The company has a history of capacity expansion, including the amalgamation of Anjaney Alloy Ltd. in FY15 to become the largest domestic ferro-alloy manufacturer by capacity. In 2025, new subsidiaries Maithan Fresh Private Limited and Maithan Nutrition Private Limited were incorporated to explore agriculture and food processing opportunities.
